name: grndbrekers-bull-riding-studay2025
description: GRNDbrekers Bull Riding Leaderboard voor StuDAY 2025 - Multi-device setup

scripts.prestart:
node -e "console.log('
🛡️  BELANGRIJK: Controleer eerst firewall setup!
'); console.log('Als je problemen hebt met GSM verbinding:
'); console.log('1. Open PowerShell als Administrator
2. Run: .\firewall-setup.ps1
3. Dan: npm start
'); console.log('Of run: npm run setup-complete voor volledige setup
');"
scripts.test-server: node -e "const http = require('http'); http.get('http://localhost:3000/health', (res) => { console.log('✅ Server responding'); }).on('error', () => { console.log('❌ Server not responding'); });"
scripts.test-clients: node -e "const http = require('http'); http.get('http://localhost:3000/clients', (res) => { let data = ''; res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk); res.on('end', () => console.log('Connected clients:', JSON.parse(data).length)); }).on('error', () => console.log('❌ Cannot get client info'));"
scripts.ip-info: node -e "const os = require('os'); const interfaces = os.networkInterfaces(); Object.keys(interfaces).forEach(name => { interfaces[name].forEach(iface => { if (iface.family === 'IPv4' && !iface.internal) { const isHotspot = iface.address.startsWith('192.168.137') || iface.address.startsWith('192.168.43'); console.log((isHotspot ? '🔥 HOTSPOT: ' : '📍 ') + name + ': http://' + iface.address + ':3000'); } }); });"
scripts.studay-ready: npm run doctor && npm run setup-firewall

author: Serge Hanssens - GRNDbrekers
